hint: A number written right next to a letter means the two are multiplied.

hints.text: A number written right next to a letter means the two are multiplied.
$5y$ means $5$ times $y$. Put $4$ in for $y$ and work out $5 \times 4$.
Five times four is $5 \times 4 = 20$, so $5y$ equals $20$.

explanation: A number beside a variable means multiplication, so $5y$ is $5 \times y$.
Replace $y$ with its value $4$ to get $5 \times 4$.
